license.name: CIH (Independence, KY branch)
license.registry: City of Cincinnati Registered Contractors lookup (Hamilton County CAGIS ezTrak), Municipal Code Chapter 1106
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Name searches ('Contains', all contractor types) for 'CIH', 'C.I.H', 'C I H', 'Central Indiana Hardware' and 'Hardware' each returned '0 Contractors Found!'. A control search for 'Indiana' returned 4 rows and 'Construction' returned 970, so the search works. The company may be registered under another legal name; nothing found under these names. Cincinnati requires registration only for work inside city limits, and the city won't issue building permits until every contractor on the job is registered (https://www.cincinnati-oh.gov/buildings/building-permit-forms-applications/contractor-registration/). The branch is in Independence, KY, and Kentucky has no state general or specialty contractor license that covers partition installation (research/state-licensing/states.json, medium confidence, law_verified false). Nobody checked whether Independence or Kenton County has a local rule. Company site (https://cih-inc.com/): CIH = Central Indiana Hardware. It sells doors, frames, hardware, toilet partitions and accessories, and offers 'Service and Installation'. The site doesn't confirm that it installs partitions. Independence is listed among its locations; the site shows no license numbers.

license.name: AllSource Construction Specialties, LLC
license.registry: City of Cincinnati registered contractor lookup (ezTrak, hosted by CAGIS / Hamilton County), linked from the Cincinnati Department of Buildings and Inspections contractor registration page
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Searched by name with 'Contains' and all contractor types for 'AllSource', 'All Source', 'ALL-SOURCE', 'Allsource Construction' and 'Construction Specialties': 0 contractors found each time. A broad search for 'Source' returned 8 rows (Core Resources, Infrasource Construction, Midwest Construction Resources, Pride Resources) and none was AllSource. I tested the search with a known registrant (Messer Construction Co, CBRC000140), so the lookup works. Cincinnati requires a current city contractor registration for commercial work inside city limits (https://www.cincinnati-oh.gov/buildings/building-permit-forms-applications/contractor-registration/). The company is based in Indianapolis, so it would need to register before doing work in Cincinnati. It may be registered under a different trade or DBA name; the city's Contractor Registration Section (513-352-3271, option 1) can confirm. Ohio licenses only five trades at state level (electrical, HVAC, hydronics, plumbing, refrigeration), and partition installation isn't one of them. Indiana has no state general contractor license. I did not check the Indiana Secretary of State business entity record.
